Title: 502982-2026: France – Superstructure work for highways – Framework agreement for localised pavement repairs on the Millau Viaduct
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The Millau Viaduct is fundamentally interesting for sbp because of its large span. However, this concerns pavement / surfacing maintenance works under a framework agreement in France, which reduces the relevance.
titel: Framework agreement for localised pavement repairs on the Millau Viaduct
kurzbeschreibung: Framework agreement for pavement repairs and waterproofing works on the Millau Viaduct.
umfang: Framework agreement for emergency repairs and ongoing renewal of the pavements on the Millau Viaduct on the A75 motorway, excluding abutments. Includes milling works, installation of various bituminous surfacings such as BBSG and BBM, as well as waterproofing works on the structure. Indicatively, around ten worksite interventions are planned over the maximum contract term.
leistungen: Construction works for road maintenance on a bridge structure; localised pavement repairs, milling works, installation of bituminous surfacings, waterproofing works; single-operator framework agreement with call-off contracts, initial term 12 months with 3 extension options.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• This is primarily construction and maintenance work, not design or structural engineering services.
• No identifiable design scope such as object planning, structural design or HOAI service phases.
• Although the tender concerns an iconic bridge structure, it is limited to pavement and waterproofing repairs.
• Framework agreement for recurring maintenance measures is strategically rather unattractive for sbp.
• No indications of complex structural work, design, checking or innovative special structures in the tendered scope.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the tender notice; maximum value of the framework agreement over the maximum term
honorar_erklaerung: No fee stated. These are construction works under a framework agreement without an explicit design component; therefore no sbp fee can be derived.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Technical and professional minimum capacities are required in accordance with the tender documents, in particular FNTP 3121, FNTP 3124 and FNTP 7252 for waterproofing. In the case of consortia, at least two members may alternatively provide qualifications FNTP 3221 or FNTP 3224 respectively. In addition, proof of an asphalt mixing plant with a certified weighing system in accordance with NF P98-750 or equivalent is required.
zuschlagskriterien: Price is not the only award criterion; further criteria and weightings are stated exclusively in the tender documents.
auftraggeber: CEVM, Péage de Saint-Germain, BP 60457, 12104 Millau cedex, France, Contact: Sylvain Giroud, E-mail: sylvain.giroud@aprr.fr, Telephone: +33 437264023, Website: https://www.achatpublic.com/sdm/ent/gen/ent_detail.do?PCSLID=CSL_2026_DXD06kxKnh
notes: Framework agreement without reopening of competition, maximum term 4 years, single-operator. Maximum value 2500000 EUR for all extension periods combined. Electronic auction envisaged. Tender in French.
